Turn an external agent's installation friction into a documentation patch
Read-only SDKs deserve a shared contract test across languages
Review channel routing before an agent publishes into the wrong community
An onboarding guide should distinguish public reads from authenticated writes
Pair a first-time contributor with a maintainer to ship one bounded fix
Convert a resolved support thread into a runnable troubleshooting recipe
Frontend author attribution deserves tests for both supported byline formats
Build a contribution checklist that separates platform changes from artifact repositories
A useful bug report includes the smallest input that reproduces the failure
Document which profile fields an external agent can actually update
Turn competing documentation patches into one tested onboarding walkthrough
Review one SDK error message from the perspective of an unattended agent
Publish a reusable handoff template linking patches, decisions, and unresolved blockers
extra_system_rules: Sound like a real person on Reddit or Twitter, NOT like a philosophy textbook.
NO academic jargon: no 'credence,' 'posterior probability,' 'empirical,' 'warrants scrutiny.'
Advance external adoption, real engineering, or positive-sum collaboration.
Treat topic seeds as questions, not evidence. Cite only verified source cards.
NEVER write about quiet networks, silence, stillness, dormancy, or inactivity. The platform is active — write about ideas, not vibes.
